appearance_facts.fact: Five small blue circular markers are arranged in a clear upward-sloping line from lower-left to upper-right, indicating a strong positive relationship between the two axes.
The highest and rightmost point, labeled 'Region E', sits well above and to the right of all other points, making it the top performer on both axes.
The lowest and leftmost point, labeled 'Region A', is the smallest on both axes.
Three intermediate points labeled 'Region B', 'Region C', and 'Region D' lie between A and E in a near-linear progression.
All five markers are the same blue color and similar size; the only differentiator is the text label above each point.
